== Summary ==
Cropped distribution copy of the Decipher card face for [[Yavin 4: Briefing Room]].

The 490 × 350 pixel image is the exact RGB crop (3, 3)–(493, 353) of [[:File:ANH-L-yavin4briefingroom-decipher-archive.gif|Decipher’s complete 506 × 367 pixel image]], with the outer drop shadow removed. The printed text, artwork, icons, frame and copyright line are pixel-identical.<ref name="decipher-cropped-copy">[https://web.archive.org/web/20021202144951id_/http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/light/images/yavin4briefingroom.gif original Decipher card-list image] (complete GIF, SHA-1 <code>9f2dced7894814315d04eb0d3c4e568eac3b29a3</code>) and [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Images-HT/starwars/ANewHope-Light/large/yavin4briefingroom.gif Players Committee Holotable distribution copy] (SHA-1 <code>1491744ec88954d40e43f889310fab3c1af385ea</code>).</ref>

The copy is hosted in the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Images-HT/starwars/ANewHope-Light/large/yavin4briefingroom.gif Players Committee Holotable distribution copy].
